cloche.ouvrir: Notifications, {nombre, plural, =0 {none unread} one {# unread} other {# unread}}

alerte.message: In “{tableau}”, “{mesure}” is {valeur}. The threshold of {seuil} has been {sens, select, au_dessus {reached or exceeded} other {reached or crossed downward}}.

email.pied: You are receiving this message because you are a recipient of a dashboard alert. This is an automated message, please do not reply.

editeur.destinatairesAide: You are always notified in the app. Tick the dashboard readers to notify as well: each one receives the value calculated with their own access rights.
editeur.aucunLecteur: Share the dashboard with readers first to be able to notify them.
editeur.email: Also send an e-mail to the recipients
editeur.webhookAide: Public https:// address, without credentials or port. It receives a JSON message without any figure when the threshold is reached; internal addresses are refused.
editeur.webhookReserve: A webhook is set on this alert; only an administrator can change it.
